topic: Ellen Langer, Blank & Chanowitz (1978) Manhattan Library Copy-Machine Study: 5-Page Placebic Compliance vs 20-Page Cost Scrutiny (Low-Poly Pastel v7)
act5_climax_episode: Boundary replications confirming low-cost favors trigger automatic polite scripts while high-cost 20-page favors wake prefrontal scrutiny.

thumbnail.cover_brief: Centered powder-blue and mist-white low-poly library copy machine beside a thin five-sheet pastel stack
